q: Change the voice: They will be repairing the bridge next week.
o: The bridge will be repaired by them next week.
The bridge will being repaired by them next week.
The bridge will be repairing by them next week.
The bridge will be being repaired by them next week.
e: বাক্যটি Future Continuous Tense। এর passive গঠন: object + will be + being + past participle + by + subject। Active-এর object the bridge হয় passive-এর subject, repair-এর past participle repaired, আর they হয় object form them। Time expression next week অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। তাই সঠিক রূপ: The bridge will be being repaired by them next week. Will be repaired হলো Future Indefinite-এর passive, এতে continuous ভাব থাকে না; will being-এ be বাদ পড়েছে; আর be repairing-এ verb active থেকে গেছে।

q: 'The sudden noise frightened the horse.'
o: The sudden horse frightened by the noise
The noise frightened the horse suddenly
The horse frightened the noise suddenly
The horse was frightened by the sudden noise
e: Past Indefinite active-এর passive-এ was/were + V3 বসে, আর কর্ম হয় কর্তা: The horse was frightened by the sudden noise। অর্থ: হঠাৎ শব্দে ঘোড়াটি ভয় পেল। প্রথম অপশনে was নেই আর বিশেষণ ভুল জায়গায়। দ্বিতীয় অপশন এখনো active। তৃতীয়টিতে কর্তা-কর্ম উল্টে গেছে।

q: Choose the correct passive form: 'Mother was preparing food.'
o: Food was prepared by mother.
Food was being prepared by mother.
Food is being prepared by mother.
Food had been prepared by mother.
e:
Active বাক্যটি Past Continuous Tense-এর। এর Passive হয় Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject। অতএব Food was being prepared by mother শুদ্ধ। অন্য বিকল্পে Tense বদলে গেছে বলে ভুল।
মনে রাখুন:
Continuous Tense-এর Passive-এ being সবসময় থাকে।
উদাহরণ: They are repairing the road → The road is being repaired by them।
